description: the-total-number-of-dams-supervised-by-the-ministry-of-energy-infrastructure-2023 is a dataset listed in Ajmandata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ministry of Energy & Infrastructure. The data set represents the total number of dams supervised by the Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure. Coverage: Ajman emirate. The portal shows 6 records. The portal shows 2024-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ajman-ae-portal.
